name: jarvis-mobile
description: Capacitor shell around the Jarvis web client — native capabilities + OTA web updates.
//deps: Capacitor core, CLI, Android, and iOS use compatible major-8 ranges and are installed together with npm install.

scripts.sync: node sync-web.mjs && node generate-android-icons.mjs && npx cap sync && node apply-android-native.mjs && node apply-context-native.mjs generated --install-pods-if-needed
scripts.sync:android: node sync-web.mjs && node generate-android-icons.mjs && npx cap sync android && node apply-android-native.mjs && node apply-context-native.mjs android
scripts.sync:ios: node sync-web.mjs && npx cap sync ios && node apply-context-native.mjs ios --install-pods-if-needed
